EMAIL.description: Attackers can use exposed email addresses to send convincing phishing messages.
Previously leaked passwords may be tested against this email address.

PHONE.description: Attackers may attempt SIM swapping to gain control of phone-based authentication.
Fraudulent SMS messages may target the exposed phone number.

PERSON.description: Publicly exposed names can help attackers build convincing social engineering profiles.

PASSWORD.description: Exposed passwords can directly lead to unauthorized account access.

URL.description: Public URLs may reveal additional personal or professional information.

DEVELOPER_PLATFORM.description: Public repositories may reveal technologies, projects, or sensitive code.
